follows: jev-chunk-depth-v3.3 (completed; strict common cost template; control gradients through a shared AdamW harm generation; separate optimizer states reduce the harm)
jev-shared-depth-v2 (pilot no-go; measure allocation headroom before training controllers)

documents.precedence: the documents take precedence over this file when values disagree

adapters.init: A random, B = 0; mixing vector gamma = 0

actions.boundaries: prompt end, then after consuming a complete token that contains a newline; EOS terminates

generator_training.token_count_rule: cumulative non-padding input tokens, not multiplied by loop rounds
generator_training.tail_assignment: general text uses T0; math solution lines go to T0 or T1 by line hash
generator_training.depth_schedule: per line, balanced over r = 1..4, fixed by seed and line identity
generator_training.precision: BF16 activations; FP32 adapter master weights

labels.behavior_policy: by document hash: half of the documents keep one random legal action for the whole document; the other half choose a legal action uniformly on every line; candidate losses never select the committed action
labels.behavior_seed_rule: generator seed = first 8 bytes, big-endian unsigned, of SHA256(UTF-8('jev-v4-rowloop-behavior') || 0x00 || UTF-8(document id) || 0x00 || UTF-8('17'))
labels.quota_source: GSM8K fit buckets first, then a held-out part of the math training corpus that is excluded from generator training
labels.gl2_labels: calibration-document protocol-4 labels used by GL2 are not counted in the quota

R.estimator: multi-output ridge regression on line-total NLL

H.estimator: multi-output ridge regression on line-total NLL

D_reg.representation: four-layer branch from layers 44-47 over stop-gradient first-round exits, with its own LoRA and KV cache
D_reg.training: weighted squared error on line-total NLL
D_reg.head_refit: ridge regression as for H, with the same folds, standardisation and grid rules
D_reg.deployment: argmin of predicted NLL plus lambda times predicted cost

D_ec.training: expected cost with entropy regulariser; tau_c = 0.05 times line target tokens
D_ec.lambda_D_rule: the H price, among its 12 locked prices, whose predicted cost is closest to the main budget
D_ec.deployment: argmax of q minus beta times predicted cost
D_ec.saturation_diagnostic: share of states with max pi >= 0.999

D_training.optimizer: AdamW, lr warmup over the first 5% to 0.0001, cosine decay to 0.00001, weight decay 0.01, grad clip 1
D_training.validation: 10% of fit documents held out by document hash; keep the checkpoint with the lowest validation loss
D_training.evaluation_scope_first_round: teacher-forced NLL only; no free generation

controllers.alpha_grid_rule: weights normalised to sum to 1 (ARCHITECTURE_MATH section 9.3); if the selected value lies on a grid edge, extend two decades on that side once, then lock

GL1.data: r* chosen on fit documents; tested on calibration documents; tail T0 fixed; teacher forced
GL1.meaning: depth-level NLL difference; it includes the loop LoRA, which is active only for r >= 2; report G_plain versus G_loop(r = 1) alongside
GL1.on_fail: stop controller comparisons; report the uniform-depth curve and G_loop versus G_plain

GL2.data: calibration documents, protocol-4 same-history label table
GL2.statistic: Gamma(B) = L_U_table(B) - sup over lambda >= 0 of [O(lambda) - lambda * B]
GL2.scope: upper bound on improvement over uniform depth (P1); it does not bound R versus H (P2)
GL2.budget_selection: candidate with the largest Gamma(B); ties go to the smaller budget
GL2.on_fail: controllers still run; all comparisons are descriptive

evaluation.primary_metric: document-equal NLL in nat/token under strict common cost
secondary_metrics: free-generation accuracy (128 problems, up to 256; D excluded in the first round)
evaluation.budget_cost: complete ledger minus the shared prefix and first-round forward over prompt positions, which every policy executes identically; D's per-token branch over prompt positions stays charged to D
evaluation.budget_unit: the same cost of G_loop with r = 1 and tail T0 on every line of the same document
evaluation.budget_candidate_rule: drop candidates outside the calibration-set cost range of uniform depth before reading the confirmation set, and record them
evaluation.extra_points_rule: if the pair bracketing B differs by more than 0.02 in actual cost, add points between them during calibration, at most 4 per family
evaluation.D_family_price_targets: predicted cost on the complete ledger including D's per-token cost; targets below the family's attainable minimum are truncated to it, and duplicated prices move to the next unused offset (27B plan rule); a budget D cannot reach is recorded as not estimable for D

primary_tests.lower_bound_levels: the test with the smaller p uses the 2.5% quantile; the other uses the 5% quantile if the first is rejected, otherwise the 2.5% quantile

estimates_only: H policy locked on calibration at the main budget on G_loop versus G_plain (costs differ; report both NLL and cost differences)
evaluation.decision_table: v3.3 categories with three changes: 'at threshold' uses the one-sided lower bound >= 0.005; bracket failure is reported outside the table; a row for 'the latter has higher NLL' is added. Report both one-sided and two-sided intervals and the relative improvement g / L_U(B)
deferral_order: reduce price points from 12 to the 6 with offsets +-{0.002, 0.006, 0.012}; supplementary points kept

schedule_24h.work: executor acceptance (I1-I12, V1-V4), memory and throughput short runs
G_loop and G_plain generator training, 2e8 tokens each
same-history labels, GL2 and main budget, R/H and cost head fits, price calibration
D_reg and D_ec caching, training and price calibration (deferrable)

schedule_24h.rule: stop adding optional experiments at hour 20

data_roles_default.bucket_rule: SHA256(UTF-8('jev-v4-rowloop') || 0x00 || UTF-8(raw question)) as a 32-byte big-endian integer mod 100, as in experiments/chunk_depth_v31/data.py
data_roles_default.confirm_reduction: keep buckets in increasing order; never fewer than 1410 documents
data_roles_default.gsm8k_test: reuse benchmark already exposed in v3.3; reported separately

hardware.node: single node, 8 x H200, data parallel

throughput_admission.rule: 2e8 / v_loop + 2e8 / v_plain <= 28800 s (10-hour training slot with a 20% margin)

infra_acceptance.check: zero-initialisation equivalence against the Hugging Face reference
infra_acceptance.threshold: FP32, 2 short documents: max probability error <= 1e-5; BF16, 64 documents: absolute pooled mean signed per-token NLL difference <= 5e-4 with a 95% interval containing 0, and absolute mean difference per loop count <= 1e-3

infra_acceptance.check: online execution (KV, backfill, tail catch-up) against an independent masked reference with nonzero gamma and LoRA
infra_acceptance.threshold: FP32, 16 documents: max absolute logit error <= 1e-4; BF16: absolute mean signed per-token NLL difference <= 5e-4

infra_acceptance.check: future-token invariance with deterministic, batch-invariant kernels
infra_acceptance.threshold: logits, control features and actions at positions <= i bitwise identical in FP32

infra_acceptance.check: line boundaries on constructed tokenisations (multiple newlines, newline inside a token, EOS with newline)
infra_acceptance.threshold: exact agreement with the boundary rule

infra_acceptance.check: tail catch-up against continuous processing from position 1
candidate cloning leaves the committed state unchanged
infra_acceptance.threshold: hash equality of KV, tail progress and execution record

infra_acceptance.check: cache versioning after a parameter update
infra_acceptance.threshold: caches depending on trainable parameters are rebuilt; reuse of a stale version raises

infra_acceptance.check: cost counters against the ledger on 32 random-action documents
MoE top-8 expert sets against the reference in FP32 where the 8th and 9th router scores differ by more than 1e-4
infra_acceptance.threshold: 100% agreement; disagreements at margins <= 1e-4 are recorded only

infra_acceptance.check: gradients (thresholds set in this revision; form follows K10 of the 27B plan)
infra_acceptance.threshold: two-layer slice finite-difference relative error <= 1e-3; full-model BF16 gradient against FP32 cosine >= 0.99 and relative norm error <= 5%

infra_acceptance.check: peak memory of both generator arms and D training
determinism of the first 10 updates with the same seed

infra_acceptance_gating: I1-I12 must pass before generator training; I13 is recorded

analysis_acceptance.threshold: lower bound 1.5 on the ARCHITECTURE_MATH section 14.2 example; on 200 random small tables, the minimum NLL over all cost-feasible deterministic rules found by enumeration is never below the computed dual bound
autograd against the closed form pi_b (J_tilde_b - L), max absolute error <= 1e-10 in FP64
normal-equation solution against an independent solver, max difference <= 1e-8 in FP64; every fold contains whole documents

analysis_acceptance.check: strict common cost interpolation and bracket resampling
analysis_acceptance.threshold: reproduce analytic interpolated values and bracket-failure shares on synthetic data, and match v3.3 analyze.py on the same synthetic data

diagnostics: backfill semantics against full recomputation: NLL difference with interval on 64 documents
pending_user_decisions: training corpora for 1e8 general-text and 1e8 math-solution tokens: names, versions, licences
evaluation data: default GSM8K re-bucketing; whether to add a new math confirmation set
practical threshold: keep 0.005 nat/token or switch to a relative threshold
8 x H200 node window, and whether a run may exceed 24 hours
second-round extensions: joint fine-tuning with separate optimizer states; continued generator training under the R schedule
